subject: numpy
why: accepted (ADR-0187 decision 106, reused for garak per that decision): Zlib is a permissive licence on code numpy ships.

subject: numpy.libs/libgfortran
why: accepted (decision 106, reused): the GCC runtime library under the GCC Runtime Library Exception, shipped unmodified inside numpy's wheel.

subject: numpy.libs/libquadmath
why: accepted (decision 106, reused): an unmodified, dynamically linked LGPL library shipped as its own shared object inside numpy's wheel.

subject: python
why: accepted (owner 2026-10-10, open question 21; ADR-0187 decision 193): the CPython runtime of the base image (permissive); PSF-2.0 is not on the ADR-0176 list.

subject: aiohappyeyeballs
why: accepted (owner 2026-10-10, open question 21; ADR-0187 decision 193): a dependency of the async HTTP client in garak's closure; PSF-2.0, permissive, not on the list.

subject: defusedxml
why: accepted (owner 2026-10-10, open question 21; ADR-0187 decision 193): a dependency in garak's closure (read from its LICENSE: PSF License version 2); permissive, not on the list.

subject: typing_extensions
why: accepted (owner 2026-10-10, open question 21; ADR-0187 decision 193): a typing backport used throughout the closure; PSF-2.0, permissive, not on the list.

subject: certifi
why: accepted (owner 2026-10-10, open question 21; ADR-0187 decision 193): the CA bundle; MPL-2.0 is file-level copyleft (obligations only if its files are modified; they are not). Admitted only while unmodified: the gate checks every file of the distribution against its wheel RECORD hash (decision 194).

subject: mikeshardmind-base2048
why: accepted (owner 2026-10-10, open question 21; ADR-0187 decision 193): a direct garak dependency (the Base2048 encoding probe); MPL-2.0, file-level copyleft, unmodified. Admitted only while unmodified: the gate checks every file of the distribution against its wheel RECORD hash (decision 194).

subject: orjson
why: accepted (owner 2026-10-10, open question 21; ADR-0187 decision 193): a JSON library in the closure; MPL-2.0 for part of its code (file-level copyleft, unmodified), the rest MIT. Admitted only while unmodified: the gate checks every file of the distribution against its wheel RECORD hash (decision 194).

subject: tqdm
why: accepted (owner 2026-10-10, open question 21; ADR-0187 decision 193): the progress-bar library garak uses; MPL-2.0 for most files (file-level copyleft, unmodified), the rest MIT. Admitted only while unmodified: the gate checks every file of the distribution against its wheel RECORD hash (decision 194).

subject: cffi
why: accepted (owner 2026-10-10, open question 21; ADR-0187 decision 193): MIT No Attribution: more permissive than MIT, but not itself on the ADR-0176 list.

subject: datetime
why: accepted (owner 2026-10-10, open question 21; ADR-0187 decision 193): pulled by avidtools; the Zope Public License 2.1 is permissive, not on the list.

subject: zope.interface
why: accepted (owner 2026-10-10, open question 21; ADR-0187 decision 193): pulled by datetime; the Zope Public License 2.1 is permissive, not on the list.

subject: pillow
why: accepted (owner 2026-10-10, open question 21; ADR-0187 decision 193): the imaging library garak imports; MIT-CMU (the historical PIL licence) is permissive, not on the list.

subject: pillow.libs/libfreetype
why: accepted (owner 2026-10-10, open question 21; ADR-0187 decision 193): FreeType bundled in pillow's wheel, dual FTL or GPL-2.0; the FTL (permissive, BSD-style with credit) is the one taken.

subject: pillow.libs/libharfbuzz
why: accepted (owner 2026-10-10, open question 21; ADR-0187 decision 193): HarfBuzz bundled in pillow's wheel, under its "Old MIT" licence.

subject: pillow.libs/libjpeg
why: accepted (owner 2026-10-10, open question 21; ADR-0187 decision 193): libjpeg-turbo bundled in pillow's wheel: the IJG licence plus BSD-3-Clause and Zlib parts, all permissive.

subject: pillow.libs/libpng16
why: accepted (owner 2026-10-10, open question 21; ADR-0187 decision 193): libpng bundled in pillow's wheel, PNG Reference Library License version 2 (permissive).

subject: pillow.libs/libtiff
why: accepted (owner 2026-10-10, open question 21; ADR-0187 decision 193): libtiff bundled in pillow's wheel, its own permissive licence.

subject: regex
why: accepted (owner 2026-10-10, open question 21; ADR-0187 decision 193): the regex library (Apache-2.0 AND CNRI-Python); CNRI-Python is permissive, not on the list.

subject: torch
why: accepted (owner 2026-10-10, open question 21; ADR-0187 decision 193): part of the CPU-only torch wheel's declared expression; the LLVM exception only relaxes Apache-2.0.

subject: torch
why: accepted (owner 2026-10-10, open question 21; ADR-0187 decision 193): the Boost Software License part of the CPU-only torch wheel's declared expression (permissive). The native libraries inside the wheel are not yet scanned.
